summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a (ControlType, str) member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the escape formatter (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL), Control.title(title), and a docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one legacy branch calling term.set_title with the control's second item; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, using the same is_terminal check and returning True/False; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200; tests added in test_console.py (skipped on Windows), test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Tests were not run and Black was not run (not installed); added lines were checked by hand to be at most 88 characters. Nothing was committed.
